blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—Rain or Shine achieved its first goal of securing a spot in the quarterfinals of the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup on Saturday. But coach Yeng Guiao is wary that any team the Elasto Painters face in the crossover quarters will be a tough cookie to crack, regardless of where they end up after the group stage. “We’re not thinking about who we want to face,” Guiao said after escaping Blackwater, 125-123, at Ynares Center here. “No matter who you face, you’ll have a hard time.” Rain or Shine improved to 5-3, tying Phoenix for second in Group B and owning the […]...
